Bring Your A-Game — AI Agent Idea

FixFirst

From security finding to security fix.

1What would you like to call your AI agent?

FixFirst

2The problem

Nightly security scans can identify a large number of issues, but the real challenge starts after the scan. Developers still need to work out what a finding means, why it matters, whether it affects their code and how to fix it. Technical reports can be difficult to navigate, which can slow remediation and leave findings open longer than necessary.

3The solution

FixFirst turns existing security findings into clear, developer-friendly guidance. Colleagues can ask questions in natural language, understand a finding, see the affected area and get practical remediation guidance. It can also summarise new versus resolved issues, recurring vulnerability types, ageing findings and weekly trends. The scanner remains the source of truth; FixFirst becomes the understanding and action layer.
